name: CM Spine intraoperative G-arm lumbar images (Zeng 2024, Electronics 13, 2137)
what: 208 anteroposterior lumbar images from a Geelin500-A mobile G-arm taken during surgery, 537 vertebrae labelled L1 to L5; the paper's data statement points to a GitHub repository whose README linked the set as one Google Drive file, and the repository is no longer public and the file does not open; the record cm_spine_drive_file is very likely that same file
level_truth: yes, L1 to L5 per vertebra
status: asked the corresponding authors, Dr Cheng and Dr Song, on 2026-09-10, 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-23, and on 2026-10-23 asked the journal's editorial office to have the data restored or the data statement corrected under MDPI's data policy; no answer from either by 2026-10-24
how_to_get: Wait for the authors or the editorial office; if the Drive file is restored, it is fetched as the record cm_spine_drive_file says, on the owner's word.
record: SchwingNet docs/research/data-access-requirements.md, Where each request stands (2026-10-24); the letter in the owner's Wayne State Outlook, subject tag [XR/CT Imaging Research]
